# CleanTrade - CleanTrail Indicator & CleanTrade Screener

> CleanTrail Pine Script indicator with confirmed trend signals and CleanTrade Telegram screener with real-time crypto alerts. One-time payment, lifetime access. No subscription.

## CleanTrade Screener (Telegram bot)
Real-time alerts delivered to Telegram:
- Impulse Moves (price + OI + volume spikes) - bullish and bearish
- Fair Value Gaps (FVG)
- Liquidations over $100,000
- Session Open/Close timings

Monitored pairs: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, PEPE, LDO, ADA, BNB, WIF, TON, LINK, ENA, LTC, ONDO

## CleanTrail Indicator (Pine Script)
- Clean trend-following strategy with confirmed signals
- Practical filters: EMA, RSI, Volume, ATR, Divergences
- Trailing stop logic for flexible exit planning
- Support & Resistance Zones and Pivot Levels displayed on charts
- Works for trend entries, scalping & reversals; intraday, swing traders & beginners

Delivery: ZIP archive with the .pine script and a PDF setup & user guide.
